components.name: StatsBand
components.doc: A band of three or four headline numbers, each with an optional tiny visual that proves it: a trend, an uptime strip, a latency histogram, or a dotted world. The numbers count up in a staggered sequence the first time the band is in view, then the visuals draw in. Hovering or focusing a stat swaps its detail line for one line of context and gives its visual the accent. Numbers use tabular figures and reserve their final width; screen readers get final values.

components.name: StatsBandBlock
components.doc: Preview: the band in either layout. Switching layouts plays the sequence again.

members.name: stats
members.doc: Three or four stats read best.

members.name: layout
members.doc: `plain` lets the stats float on whitespace; `divided` sets them in a hairline grid ruled above and below.

members.name: duration
members.doc: Seconds each number takes to count up. Defaults to 1.6.

members.name: locale
members.doc: Number formatting locale. Fixed by default so server and client agree.

types.name: StatVisual
types.doc: A small visual that proves the number beside it. Every kind is optional; a stat without one is just the number. - `trend`: a sparkline of a series, oldest first, such as twelve monthly totals. - `uptime`: one bar per day as a percentage. Full days are full height; a day with downtime is visibly shorter. - `distribution`: a histogram of equal width bins across `0..max`, with the bars below `marker` (the median) inked. - `map`: a dotted world with a dot lit for each [longitude, latitude] point.
types.text: | { kind: "trend"; values: number[] } | { kind: "uptime"; days: number[] } | { kind: "distribution"; bins: number[]; max: number; marker: number } | { kind: "map"; points: [number, number][] }

members.name: value
members.doc: The final number. The band counts up to it.

members.name: prefix
members.doc: Text before the number, such as "$".

members.name: suffix
members.doc: Text after the number, such as "%", "ms", or "+".

members.name: decimals
members.doc: Digits after the decimal point. Defaults to 0.

members.name: notation
members.doc: `compact` shortens large numbers to 2.3M or 12K. The unit renders like a suffix. Defaults to `standard`.

members.name: detail
members.doc: One short supporting line under the number.

members.name: context
members.doc: One line of context that replaces the detail while the stat is hovered or focused, such as "Up from 41% last year".

members.name: visual
members.doc: A tiny chart that draws in after the number lands.
